ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast with a dominant low-intensity (black) pixel majority; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to discrete circular scar patterns across the central and distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pigmentation across the entire visible surface. Discrete, high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) are distributed throughout, with higher densities on the distal tips and medial-lower sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression at the center-line; base of the notch is partially obscured by water spray, but upper convergence indicates an acute angular depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entirety of the trailing edge, characterized by small, sharp peaks and shallow valleys approximately 3-8 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trailing edge follows a moderate convex curve from the median notch to the lateral tips, with the tips themselves showing a slight upward and backward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly prominent distribution of circular white ring scars (barnacle attachment marks) across both lobes; numerous individual rosettes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface consistent with past barnacle colonization; slight irregularity in the smooth contour of the outer tips suggesting minor tissue loss or heavy callosity.
